name: @smart-workplace/workplace-worker
description: 범용 비동기 워커 (Python/FastAPI) — 파일 텍스트 추출 등. pnpm 은 dev 오케스트레이션용 래퍼만 제공하고 실제 런타임은 uv/uvicorn.

scripts.dev: set -a; [ -f ../../.env ] && . ../../.env; set +a; export WORKER_BLOB_BASE="${WORKER_BLOB_BASE:-$(cd ../workplace-api && pwd)/file-data}"; export WORKPLACE_API_BASE_URL="${WORKPLACE_API_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:9090}"; export INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN="${INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN:-${WORKPLACE_AI_AGENT_TOKEN:-changeme-local}}"; trap 'kill 0' INT TERM; uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 7080 & wait
